source_message.text:
Hey,

[FREELANCER_NAME_002] account now has funding, and I’m ready to make our arrangement official. [FREELANCER_NAME_003] aboard [FREELANCER_NAME_002] team.

This is [FREELANCER_NAME_005] confirmed offer:

**FLAT RETAINER: $400-500 per month**
This covers 100 approved clips each month. A clip is considered approved only when I personally approve it — anything that falls short of [FREELANCER_NAME_002] standard will not count toward [FREELANCER_NAME_005] monthly quota. Quality is [FREELANCER_NAME_002] top priority here.

**[FREELANCER_NAME_005] INSTAGRAM ACCOUNT**
You’ll receive a dedicated Instagram account of [FREELANCER_NAME_005] own. You will upload [FREELANCER_NAME_005] approved clips straight to that account. We track every clip, including its views, performance, and engagement, so there is full transparency at all times.

**PERFORMANCE BONUSES**
In addition to [FREELANCER_NAME_002] flat retainer, you’ll receive a bonus whenever a clip reaches a view milestone. As [FREELANCER_NAME_005] clips perform better, you can earn more beyond [FREELANCER_NAME_005] base pay. This gives you [FREELANCER_NAME_002] chance to make significantly more than [FREELANCER_NAME_002] flat fee each month.

**NEXT STEPS**
\- I’ll send [FREELANCER_NAME_002] official Upwork contract to you shortly
\- After you accept it, you’ll be given [FREELANCER_NAME_002] login for [FREELANCER_NAME_005] Instagram account
\- You’ll begin posting immediately

This opportunity is real and long term, and it is only [FREELANCER_NAME_002] start — beginning on day one, you have an open path toward becoming Lead Clipper and earning $2,000 per month.

Let’s create something great together.

[CLIENT_NAME_001]
